name: shortened barrel
description: A shortened barrel results in markedly reduced accuracy, and a minor increase in noise, but also greatly improves the ease with which the weapon can be carried and wielded.

name: upstest
description: Testmod for UPS drain on mods, this should never spawn, if you see this, it's a bug. 50 UPS drain.

name: LW barrel extension
description: A Leadworks built in longer barrel increases the muzzle velocity of a firearm, contributing to both accuracy and damage.

name: LW shortened barrel
description: A Leadworks built in shortened barrel results in reduced weapon range, and a minor increase in noise, but also greatly improves the ease with which the weapon can be carried and wielded.

name: extended pistol barrel
description: A longer replacement barrel for semi-automatic pistols.  Increases muzzle velocity, effective range, and accuracy at the cost of reduced concealability.

name: heavy barrel
description: A thick-walled replacement barrel for rifles.  Significantly improves accuracy and heat dissipation during sustained fire at the cost of considerable weight.

name: LW heavy duty barrel
description: A Leadworks built in heavy duty barrel especially designed for prolonged shooting.  Increases damage output and weapon range.
